title: Add stock reservations
task: Add reservations to the inventory crate: held stock that cannot be shipped normally. Keep existing signatures and the crate-root re-exports. In src/inventory.rs, add the StockError variant NotReserved { sku: String, requested: u32, reserved: u32 } and these Inventory methods: reserved(&self, sku: &str) -> u32 (0 for unknown SKUs); available(&self, sku: &str) -> u32, which is on_hand minus reserved; reserve(&mut self, sku: &str, qty: u32) -> Result<(), StockError>, which fails with Insufficient { sku, requested: qty, available } when qty exceeds available; release(&mut self, sku: &str, qty: u32) -> Result<(), StockError>, which returns reserved stock to available and fails with NotReserved when qty exceeds reserved; ship_reserved(&mut self, sku: &str, qty: u32) -> Result<(), StockError>, which removes qty from both on_hand and reserved and fails with NotReserved when qty exceeds reserved. ship must now only take available stock: when qty exceeds available it fails with Insufficient whose available field is the available quantity. All five fallible operations return UnknownSku for a SKU that was never received, checked before anything else; a failed operation changes nothing, and qty 0 on a known SKU succeeds. In src/report.rs, change each stock_report line to "SKU: ON_HAND on hand, RESERVED reserved, AVAILABLE available" followed by a newline, still in ascending SKU order (for example "apple: 5 on hand, 2 reserved, 3 available"). Update tests/inventory.rs for the new report format and add a tests/reservations.rs integration test covering reservations.
